definitions.gloss: to hold, to conduct, to perform (a ceremony or formal event)
definitions.explanation: To carry out a formal ceremony, ritual, or official event. A solemn, elevated word used almost exclusively for ceremonial occasions.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}を{執|と}り{行|おこな}う。
{葬儀|そうぎ}は{来週|らいしゅう}{執|と}り{行|おこな}われる{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: The funeral is scheduled to be held next week.

examples.japanese: {神社|じんじゃ}で{厳|おごそ}かに{祭典|さいてん}が{執|と}り{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A festival was solemnly conducted at the shrine.

notes:
A formal, elevated verb used almost exclusively for ceremonies, rituals, and official events. Not used for casual gatherings or everyday activities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {式|しき}を{執|と}り{行|おこな}う: to hold a ceremony
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}を{執|と}り{行|おこな}う: to hold a wedding
- {葬儀|そうぎ}を{執|と}り{行|おこな}う: to hold a funeral
- {儀式|ぎしき}を{執|と}り{行|おこな}う: to perform a ritual
- {祭典|さいてん}を{執|と}り{行|おこな}う: to conduct a festival

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {行|おこな}う: to carry out, to do — neutral and general-purpose
- {催|もよお}す: to hold, to organize — for events, exhibitions, or parties
- {挙行|きょこう}する: to hold (a ceremony) — formal written synonym, often used in announcements
